waitReason: Reopened by human steering on 2026-06-14: may-agent.app should continuously collect platform failures/issues, feed them to the owner with a compact system-review packet, and turn real abnormal signals into task-tree work before claiming the platform is healthy.
goal: Drive the May-agent platform as a v3 project app: keep runtime contracts, event/session/task execution, persistence, SDK, shared UI, and project-app conventions coherent, tested, and reusable.
strategy: Keep platform design and principles in this app's docs/ tree.
Use tasks/tree.json as the durable expression of project thinking, priorities, and accepted understanding.
Use ../may-agent as the portable domain/runtime code workspace.
Route human steering, metric signals, scheduled review, and abnormal runtime signals into event-based owner review.
Before claiming platform health, inspect open alerts, recent failures, stale project state, task-tree state, evaluator findings, and communication failures.
Keep runtime scratch in .state/ and fold durable decisions back into docs, tasks, or code.
